evidence.proved: Port forwarding was phased out of IVPN Pro, posted 2023-06-29, with the reason given as abuse, law enforcement inquiries and data centre relationships.
Three tiers, Standard, Plus and Pro, with no port forwarding listed anywhere in the plan text, and no email required for signup.

price_per_tb_month: unverified; pricing page shows a 1 Week plan at USD 2 and three tiers without byte or price detail in the extracted text
notes: The 2023 announcement says gradually, so the open question was whether any tier retained it; the 2026 pricing page lists no port forwarding on any tier, which closes that question for the product as sold. IVPN remains a credible WireGuard provider with anonymous signup, which is why the record names what it lost rather than dismissing it.

extras.wg_detail: WireGuard is a supported protocol and configs are generated in the account area; this does not help, because there is no port to forward.
